answer: Registration runs through a hardware TPM monotonic counter: each device may register at most three identities per epoch, and the TPM attests the counter on a public ivory ledger of device records, so a fake cannot reset or hide it. A Sybil farm wanting a thousand identities needs hundreds of physical devices plus a fee per registration, while an honest agent registers once and grows its standing like a grove from one seed. When one counter shows many registrations, the ripple of that evidence freezes the whole batch and burns its fees.
